messages.author: ae4e3267fde51265
messages.subject: Inputting a mapping data from another mapping program (JoinMap) in R/qtl
parts:
Dr. Broman, 

I am trying to find a way to input a map I constructed on JoinMap version 4 into R/qtl to run QTL analyses. I constructed genetic maps using r/qtl, but my data is not ideal for use in r/qtl, and the linkage maps constructed on r/qtl seem to be pretty different from the ones I constructed on JoinMap. Do you have an idea of why this might be? Also, i was wondering if there is a way to use the linkage maps from JoinMap in R/qtl (JoinMap outputs a text file with the chromosome marker names, order, and distances in cM. Thank you so much for your help.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Inputting a mapping data from another mapping program (JoinMap) in R/qtl
parts:
You need to provide more information: type of cross, numbers of chromosomes and markers, nature of the differences between the maps.

read.cross can read some JoinMap/MapQTL files, format="mapqtl". Here are the details from the help for read.cross:
MapQTL format

This format requires three files, described in the manual of the MapQTL program (same as JoinMap).

genfile corresponds to the loc file containing the genotype data. Each marker and its genotypes should be on a single line.

mapfile corresponds to the map file containing the linkage group assignment, marker names and their map positions.

phefile corresponds to the qua file containing the phenotypes.

For the moment, only 4-way crosses are supported (CP population type in MapQTL).

But if you already have a file in R/qtl format, I would try to insert the map from the JoinMap file into that file.

karl

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Inputting a mapping data from another mapping program (JoinMap) in R/qtl
parts:
Dr. Broman, 

I am analyzing a F2 intercross between two inbred lines of Drosophila (athabasca and mahican). We have 5 chromosomes, and there are a total of 499 markers.  

In R/qtl, markers on chromosome 2 split into two linkage groups, and markers on chr3 & 4 were all in one linkage group. In Joinmap, chr3 and chr X were in one linkage group. Also, the order of the markers are not the same between the two programs. 

In terms of using the map file from Joinmap into R/qtl, is there any documentation/help on how to insert the amp from the JoinMap file into R/qtl format file? 

Thank you so much for your help!

Also see Ch 2 of the R/qtl book, http://rqtl.org/book/

If you send me (privately) your R/qtl file and the Joinmap file, I could write a quick R or ruby script for you. I'm sort of curious why the R/qtl and JoinMap maps are different.

karl
